Lorem Ipsum comes from sections 1.10.32 and 1.10.33 of the book "De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum" (On the Extremes of Good and Evil) written by Cicero in 45 BCE. This book is a discussion of ethical theory, very popular during the Renaissance. The first sentence of Lorem Ipsum, "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet..", comes from section 1.10.32. Welcome Parameters Healthcare Network Profile sharing Notifications eZdravlje is your unique application that offers you fast and secure access to all health data in the Republic of Serbia. Enjoy the simple synchronization of biometric data with your devices, so that your data is always up-to-date. View prescriptions and therapies, access the electronic medical record, information on sick leave and schedule appointments with your chosen doctor - all in one place! Connect with doctors and other users via audio, video and chat communication, and always stay up to date. Share and access the data of other users of the application, building a community of trust and information exchange. Regardless of whether you visit a doctor, use therapy or enjoy events on the platform, our system of reminders and notifications will always inform you about the next step in a timely manner.
